trigger_params.title: HSCC: orchestrator/DGX unhealthy
trigger_params.body: The orchestrator node / DGX check is failing — inference may be down.

trigger_params.title: HSCC: vLLM backend down
trigger_params.body: The orchestrator vLLM endpoint is not serving.

trigger_params.title: HSCC: pipeline watchdog blocked
trigger_params.body: The pipeline watchdog tripped its circuit breaker — dispatch is halted.

trigger_params.title: HSCC: inference engine wedged
trigger_params.body: A serving unit answered HTTP 200 but streamed no generated tokens — the engine is wedged (answering but not generating), not merely down.
